description: Option-2 eigenfunction-level probe: bar-evenness of the interpolating ladder, exactness of the Whipple argument involution and the zeta_4 quarter-period channel shift, plus 50-dps verification that the toroidal Legendre pair exchanges degree and order with a sqrt(sinh)-Jacobian (Whipple).
discipline: no fit; sympy exact + mpmath 50 dps; discovery outputs labeled; (a)-scoped.
verdict: EIGENFUNCTION-LEVEL STRUCTURE CONSISTENT, IDENTIFICATION STAYS A LEAD: the interpolating ladder is bar-EVEN ([d] invariant under q -> q^{-1}); the Whipple cosh<->coth argument exchange is an exact involution (the geometric winding exchange); the zeta_4 quarter-period shift maps the cosh channel to i*sinh (corpus Lean-certified); and numerically at 50 dps the toroidal pair P^{-mu}_{nu-1/2}(coth a) / Q^nu_{mu-1/2}(cosh a) (pairing discovered by a 48-combo scan; DLMF 14.9.16 convention) is sqrt(sinh a)-proportional with an a-independent constant (degree<->order exchange verified at two generic (nu, mu) points), whose Gamma-shift laws r_mu = +1/(nu+mu+1/2) and r_nu = -1/(nu+mu+1/2) are recorded as discovery output — one Gamma(nu+mu+1/2) with an alternating nu-sign. SCOPE (a): these are the necessary structural facts for 'rotation_step archimedean shadow = Whipple involution'; the identification itself remains an open lead (audit S9) and nothing here touches production or observables.
